records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $117 million in 2024, or 1%, when compared to the previous year primarily due to lower fuel recovery and lower coal revenue, which includes the impact of lower global benchmark rates.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These decreases were partially offset by pricing gains in merchandise as well as higher merchandise and intermodal volumes.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Trucking revenue decreased $38 million versus the prior year due to lower fuel and capacity surcharges.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Expenses of $9.3 billion increased $137 million or 1% year over year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Operating income of $5.2 billion decreased $254 million or 5% year over year.
